```{=html}
<style>
/* Scoped under .flyer so it can't disturb the Quarto theme. */
.flyer, .flyer * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.flyer {
  --navy: #00205B;
  --gold: #b8912f;
  --ink:  #1a1a1a;
  --gray: #444;
  --mut:  #6b6b6b;
  --line: #e4e4e4;
  font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin: 8px 0 24px;
}

.flyer .sheet {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 24px 8px 8px;
  background: transparent;
}

/* ---- Masthead ---------------------------------------------------------- */

.flyer .eyebrow {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 17px;
  letter-spacing: 4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.flyer .display {
  text-align: center;
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: 48px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.flyer .meta-inline {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px 18px;
}
.flyer .meta-inline span { font-size: 18px; color: #333; }
.flyer .meta-inline .dot { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }

.flyer .subline {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #555;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.flyer .subline b { color: var(--ink); }

.flyer .rule {
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin: 26px 0 22px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--navy) 0 62%, var(--gold) 62% 100%);
}

/* ---- Week headings ----------------------------------------------------- */

.flyer .section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin: 20px 0 10px;
}
.flyer .section-head .label,
.flyer .section-head .dates {
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 2.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ---- Session rows ------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Three columns: date chip | title and description | download links.
   The chip is a plain label. Downloads are named links at the right of the
   row, so they are visible without hovering and work on touch. */

.flyer .item {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 8px 0;
}

.flyer .chip {
  flex: 0 0 140px;
  background: var(--navy);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 7px 0;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: block;
}
.flyer .chip .chip-time {
  display: block;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  opacity: 0.85;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

/* flex-basis 0 so the text shrinks to share the row rather than wrapping
   below the chip once .item is allowed to wrap on narrow screens. */
.flyer .item-body {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
.flyer .item-title {
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
}
.flyer .item-desc {
  font-size: 15.5px;
  color: var(--gray);
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.flyer .item-links {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-left: auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding-top: 3px;
}
.flyer .item-links a {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.flyer .item-links a:hover,
.flyer .item-links a:focus { text-decoration: underline; }
.flyer .item-links a:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--gold);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.flyer .item-links .sep {
  color: var(--gold);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 7px;
}

/* ---- Footer ------------------------------------------------------------ */

.flyer .sheet-foot {
  margin-top: 28px;
  padding-top: 18px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}
.flyer .sheet-foot a {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.flyer .sheet-foot .url  { font-size: 20px; }
.flyer .sheet-foot .zoom { font-size: 17px; }

/* ---- Narrow screens ---------------------------------------------------- */

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .flyer .display { font-size: 33px; }
  .flyer .chip { flex-basis: 108px; font-size: 12px; }
  .flyer .chip .chip-time { font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .flyer .item-title { font-size: 17px; }

  /* Too narrow for a third column, so the links wrap onto their own line,
     indented to line up with the session title above them. */
  .flyer .item { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .flyer .item-links {
    flex: 1 0 100%;
    margin-left: 0;
    padding-left: 124px;
    padding-top: 5px;
  }
  .flyer .item-links a { font-size: 14px; }
}
</style>

<!-- To post a session's material, add an item-links div to that row:

       <div class="item-links"><a href="PATH">Slides</a><span class="sep">&middot;</span><a href="PATH">Files</a></div>

     Keep that div's contents on one line: the links are inline, so a line
     break between them would show up as an extra space around the dot.
     Paths are relative to docs/, e.g. slides/2_productivity.html. Anything
     linked must also be listed under resources: in _quarto.yml.           -->

<div class="flyer">
  <div class="sheet">

    <div class="eyebrow">Faculty Workshop &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; August 2026</div>
    <h1 class="display">Claude for Teaching &amp; Research</h1>
    <div class="meta-inline">
      <span>Eight 1-hour sessions</span><span class="dot">&bull;</span>
      <span>Zoom</span>
    </div>
    <div class="subline">led by <b>Kerry Back</b></div>
    <div class="rule"></div>

    <div class="section-head">

    </div>

    <div class="item">
      <div class="chip">AUG 10<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></div>
      <div class="item-body">
        <div class="item-title">Intro to Claude</div>
        <div class="item-desc">Claude Desktop (Chat, Cowork, Code &mdash; Local and Cloud), Claude plugin for Excel</div>
      </div>
      <div class="item-links"><a href="slides/1_intro-to-claude.html">Slides</a><span class="sep">&middot;</span><a href="files/session1.zip">Files</a></div>
    </div>

    <div class="item">

      <div class="item-body">

      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="item">
      <div class="chip">AUG 12<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></div>
      <div class="item-body">
        <div class="item-title">Skills, Connectors, and Plugins</div>
        <div class="item-desc">customizing Claude and adding capabilities</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="item">
      <div class="chip">AUG 13<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></div>
      <div class="item-body">
        <div class="item-title">Research and Teaching Setup</div>
        <div class="item-desc">Academic Studio, Python, R, LaTeX, Quarto, Git, GitHub</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="item">
      <div class="chip">AUG 14<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></div>
      <div class="item-body">
        <div class="item-title">AI for Teaching</div>
        <div class="item-desc">NotebookLM, RAG chatbots, slide voice-overs</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="label">Week 2</span>
      <span class="dates">August 17&ndash;19</span>
    </div>

    <div class="item">
      <div class="chip">AUG 17<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></div>
      <div class="item-body">
        <div class="item-title">Student Projects</div>
        <div class="item-desc">artifacts, apps, agents</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="item">
      <div class="chip">AUG 19<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></div>
      <div class="item-body">
        <div class="item-title">AI for Research</div>
        <div class="item-desc">literature search, knowledge databases, writing, and reviews</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="item">
      <div class="chip">AUG 19<span class="chip-time">4:00&ndash;5:00 PM</span></div>
      <div class="item-body">
        <div class="item-title">Agent Assistants</div>
        <div class="item-desc">research team, personal assistants</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="sheet-foot">
      <a class="url" href="https://rice-workshop.kerryback.com">rice-workshop.kerryback.com</a>
      <a class="zoom" href="https://jgsb.zoom.us/j/95657980099?pwd=Ve5TMEaaBRQnhWnhnpaJFDHevFIbRU.1">Join on Zoom &rarr;</a>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>
```
